title: Inverse image and direct image along a morphism on small pro-etale sites
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], with small pro-etale sites $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. The base-change functor $u_f:Y_{\mathrm{proet}}\to X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, $(V\to Y)\mapsto(X\times_YV\to X)$, is well defined because weakly etale maps are stable under base change, and it sends coverings to coverings and commutes with fibre products and the final object; it therefore defines a morphism of sites $f_{\mathrm{proet}}:X_{\mathrm{proet}}\to Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$. For a sheaf $\mathcal G$ (of sets, abelian groups, rings or modules) on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ the *direct image* is $f_*\mathcal G(V)=\mathcal G(X\times_YV)$. For a sheaf $\mathcal F$ on $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ the *inverse image* $f^{-1}\mathcal F$ is the sheafification of the presheaf
$$
 U\longmapsto\varinjlim_{(V,\ U\to X\times_YV)}\mathcal F(V),
$$
the colimit over the category of pairs of an object $V$ of $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ and an $X$-morphism $U\to X\times_YV$. Then $f^{-1}$ is left adjoint to $f_*$; write $\eta_f:\mathcal F\to f_*f^{-1}\mathcal F$ and $\varepsilon_f:f^{-1}f_*\mathcal G\to\mathcal G$ for the unit and counit. For a commutative ring $A$, with constant sheaves $A_Y$, $A_X$ (sheafifications of the constant presheaves with value $A$), the *structure map*
$$
 c^f_A:f^{-1}A_Y\longrightarrow A_X
$$
is the morphism of sheaves of rings adjoint to the morphism $A_Y\to f_*A_X$ obtained, by the universal property of sheafification, from the map of presheaves sending $a\in A$ to the image of the constant section $a$ in $A_X(X\times_YV)$, for every $V$. On sheaves of $A_Y$-modules, $f^{-1}$ produces sheaves of $f^{-1}A_Y$-modules, which become $A_X$-modules by $f^{-1}(-)\otimes_{f^{-1}A_Y}A_X$ along $c^f_A$, and $f_*$ produces $A_Y$-modules through $A_Y\to f_*A_X$.
